currentParagraphText: “Yip of Yore,” Nature’s Attendant said with a sigh. “He was... how to put it... a wake-up call. To many of us. This is something I don’t share with you lightly, but there was genuine concern even amongst some of the top factions as Yip rose to power and only kept rising.”

finalResult.previousParagraphText: “What do you mean?” Artemis asked, genuinely unsure of what he was getting at.
